Company's ARR grew 17x since January, with more than 10,000 startups and enterprise companies running builds and tests on its platform.

, /PRNewswire/ -- Blacksmith, the infrastructure platform for building and testing code, today announced a $66M Series C led by Sequoia Capital at a $1 billion valuation, with participation from Premji Invest and existing investors Peak XV Partners, GV and Y Combinator. The round brings Blacksmith's total funding to $125 million and will enable the company to grow its team and expand its compute footprint.

For years, writing code was the slow part of shipping software. With AI coding agents now producing a large and growing share of the world's code, the burden has changed from writing code to validating it. Every change still has to be built and tested before it can be merged, a step known as continuous integration, or CI.

Most companies run CI on general-purpose cloud infrastructure that was never designed for it. As developers push more code, teams hit longer waits for compute, slower builds on older-generation CPUs, and a constant fight between over- and under-provisioning. Anthropic reported last month that its own CI volume grew 25x in six months as Claude took over most of its code output.

"Since Claude Code took off in March, almost every conversation we've had with a large engineering team has started the same way. Developers who used to push three or four pull requests a day are now pushing orders of magnitude more and their CI infrastructure can't keep up. We're grateful to our customers who are trusting us to solve this bottleneck, and excited to partner with Sequoia to solve it at scale," said Aditya "JP" Jayaprakash, co-founder and CEO of Blacksmith.

CI is the most variable workload a company runs: a single customer's demand regularly jumps from zero to tens of thousands of CPUs and back again. Blacksmith has designed every part of its infrastructure stack to absorb those spikes as a matter of routine. Customers switch with a one-line change to their workflow file and never provision, scale or maintain their CI infrastructure again. Developers using Blacksmith see their CI jobs complete twice as fast and at 60% lower cost on average, with zero operational overhead. Since January, the number of CI jobs running on Blacksmith each week has grown from 5 million to more than 90 million, and annual recurring revenue has grown 17x.

"JP and team understood early that as AI agents wrote more code, the infrastructure to build and test it would need to change," said Isaiah Boone, Partner at Sequoia Capital. "What stood out to us was their deep systems expertise and speed of execution. That has translated into a product that helps their customers test and ship their software faster. We believe that foundation gives Blacksmith room to build much more as the demands of software development change."

Blacksmith was founded in 2024 by Jayaprakash, Aayush Shah and Aditya Maru, who met as undergraduates at the University of Waterloo. Shah and Maru were early engineers at Cockroach Labs, and Jayaprakash was an engineer at Faire. All three are developers who have run spiky, large-scale infrastructure before, and they built Blacksmith on the bet that testing code, not writing it, would become the constraint on shipping software.

More than 10,000 companies, including Ashby, Granola, Handshake and LangChain, now run their CI on Blacksmith. The company manages nearly 10 MW of compute across data centers in the United States and Europe and is on track to grow that footprint at least 5x in 2027.

"Blacksmith has significantly reduced the burden of managing our CI runners while cutting our runner costs by roughly 40%, and that doesn't even account for the engineering time we've saved," said Joaquin Borggio, Infrastructure Engineer at LangChain.

To learn more or move your CI to Blacksmith, visit blacksmith.sh. Blacksmith is hiring engineers in New York and San Francisco at blacksmith.sh/careers. Follow Blacksmith on LinkedIn and X.

About Blacksmith

Blacksmith is the infrastructure platform for building and testing code. Companies bring Blacksmith their builds and tests, and Blacksmith runs them twice as fast and at 60% lower cost on average, on infrastructure purpose-built for CI workloads. More than 10,000 companies, including Ashby, Granola, Handshake and LangChain, run their CI on Blacksmith. The company was founded in 2024 by Aditya (JP) Jayaprakash, Aayush Shah and Aditya Maru and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Premji Invest, Peak XV Partners, GV and Y Combinator. For more information, visit blacksmith.sh.

SOURCE Blacksmith

translation.html:
自1月以来，公司的年度经常性收入（ARR）增至原来的17倍，已有超过10,000家初创企业和大型企业在其平台上运行构建和测试。

, /美通社/ -- 用于构建和测试代码的基础设施平台Blacksmith今日宣布完成6600万美元的C轮融资，由Sequoia Capital领投，估值达10亿美元，Premji Invest及现有投资者Peak XV Partners、GV和Y Combinator参投。本轮融资使Blacksmith的累计融资额达到1.25亿美元，将帮助公司扩充团队并扩大计算基础设施规模。

多年来，编写代码一直是软件交付过程中耗时的环节。如今，AI编程智能体生成的代码在全球代码总量中占据了相当大且持续增长的比例，工作重心也从编写代码转向验证代码。每次变更在合并之前仍必须经过构建和测试，这一步称为持续集成，简称CI。

大多数公司在通用云基础设施上运行CI，而这些基础设施从未针对CI设计。随着开发者推送更多代码，团队面临计算资源等待时间更长、老一代CPU上的构建速度更慢，以及始终难以在资源配置过多与不足之间取得平衡等问题。Anthropic上个月报告称 ，随着Claude承担了其大部分代码产出，公司自身的CI工作量在六个月内增至原来的25倍。

Blacksmith联合创始人兼首席执行官Aditya “JP” Jayaprakash表示：“自Claude Code在3月迅速普及以来，我们与大型工程团队的几乎每次交流都以同样的话题开始。过去每天推送三四个拉取请求的开发者，如今推送的数量增长了数个数量级，而他们的CI基础设施已经跟不上了。我们感谢客户信任我们来解决这一瓶颈，也很高兴能与Sequoia合作，大规模解决这个问题。”

CI是公司运行的各类工作负载中波动最大的一种：单个客户的需求经常从零跃升至数万颗CPU，然后又回落至零。Blacksmith在设计基础设施栈的每个部分时，都将从容应对这些峰值作为常规要求。客户只需修改工作流文件中的一行即可切换，此后无需再为CI基础设施配置资源、扩容或维护。使用Blacksmith的开发者，其CI作业完成速度可达原来的两倍，成本平均降低60%，且无需承担任何运维工作。自1月以来，Blacksmith每周运行的CI作业数量已从500万次增长至超过9000万次，年度经常性收入增至原来的17倍。

Sequoia Capital合伙人Isaiah Boone表示：“JP和团队很早就意识到，随着AI智能体编写更多代码，用于构建和测试代码的基础设施也需要改变。他们深厚的系统专业知识和执行速度给我们留下了深刻印象。这些优势转化为一款帮助客户更快测试和交付软件的产品。我们相信，随着软件开发需求的变化，这一基础将为Blacksmith提供打造更多产品与能力的空间。”

Blacksmith由Jayaprakash、Aayush Shah和Aditya Maru于2024年创立，三人在滑铁卢大学读本科时相识。Shah和Maru曾是Cockroach Labs的早期工程师，Jayaprakash则曾在Faire担任工程师。三人都是开发者，此前都曾运营过负载波动剧烈的大规模基础设施。他们创立Blacksmith，是基于这样一个判断：测试代码将取代编写代码，成为制约软件交付的因素。

目前，包括Ashby、Granola、Handshake和LangChain在内的超过10,000家公司在Blacksmith上运行CI。公司在美国和欧洲的数据中心管理着功率规模接近10兆瓦的计算基础设施，并有望在2027年将这一规模扩大至目前的至少5倍。

LangChain基础设施工程师Joaquin Borggio表示：“Blacksmith显著减轻了我们管理CI运行器的负担，同时将运行器成本降低了约40%，这还没有算上我们节省的工程时间。”

如需了解更多信息或将CI迁移至Blacksmith，请访问blacksmith.sh。Blacksmith正在纽约和旧金山招聘工程师，职位信息见blacksmith.sh/careers。欢迎在LinkedIn 和X上关注Blacksmith。

关于Blacksmith

Blacksmith是用于构建和测试代码的基础设施平台。企业将构建和测试任务交给Blacksmith，Blacksmith在专为CI工作负载打造的基础设施上运行这些任务，速度可达原来的两倍，成本平均降低60%。包括Ashby、Granola、Handshake和LangChain在内的超过10,000家公司在Blacksmith上运行CI。公司由Aditya (JP) Jayaprakash、Aayush Shah和Aditya Maru于2024年创立，获得了Sequoia Capital、Premji Invest、Peak XV Partners、GV和Y Combinator的投资支持。更多信息请访问blacksmith.sh。

来源 Blacksmith
